property_summary: C.transfer returns true if and only if the call to caddress succeeds for every receiver.
C.transfer reverts exactly when its returned bool would be false, i.e., success is equivalent to non-reversion.

If the loop over the supplied target addresses completes successfully by having every call return true, transfer returns true and does not revert; any other outcome makes the whole call revert, so no successful call can execute a failing transferFrom.
